items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: Yeah, Robichaux. But Happy was pretty good.

ctx.x: I knew him in New York. Oh, yeah. I remember them all, yeah. I remember when he played at the Lyrics Theater. Oh, yeah.
Is that Robichaux's band? Yeah, uh-huh.
Yeah, Robichaux. But Happy was pretty good. Which Happy was that?
